description: This file contains inline functions and macros for bit manipulation utilities used internally in jemalloc, including functions for finding the first set bit, computing the next power of two, and bit scanning optimized for different architectures.

methods.name: ffs_llu
methods.description: Find first set bit in an unsigned long long integer.

methods.name: ffs_lu
methods.description: Find first set bit in an unsigned long integer.

methods.name: ffs_u
methods.description: Find first set bit in an unsigned integer.

methods.name: ffs_zu
methods.description: Find first set bit in a size_t value, selecting implementation based on pointer size.

methods.name: ffs_u64
methods.description: Find first set bit in a 64-bit unsigned integer, selecting implementation based on long type size.

methods.name: ffs_u32
methods.description: Find first set bit in a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: pow2_ceil_u64
methods.description: Compute the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x for 64-bit integers.

methods.name: pow2_ceil_u32
methods.description: Compute the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x for 32-bit integers.

methods.name: pow2_ceil_zu
methods.description: Compute the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x for size_t, choosing implementation based on pointer size.

methods.name: lg_floor
methods.description: Calculate the floor of the binary logarithm of x, optimized for different architectures and compiler features.
